integrity: Proof uses exact formal identities. Finite integer checks are supplementary. Claims of independent certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies common coefficient moduli and first obstructions, not every individual coefficient valuation. Prime-parameter and non-prime-power premises are credited to Sharma; implicit prior coverage by general lifting theory remains possible.
title: Optimal congruence moduli and first obstructions for hook-length and core-partition series
